card.statement:
If we take the $z\rightarrow 0$ limit on the $D$ -modules, the quantum Hikita conjecture specializes to an isomorphism $B(\mathcal{A})\cong H^{*}_{T^{!}\times\mathbb{G}_{m}}(X^{!})$ as graded modules over $\mathrm{Sym}\mathcal{A}_{0}^{2}\cong\mathrm{Sym}H^{2}_{T^{!}\times\mathbb{G}_{m}}(X^{!})$ , which is a priori weaker than the algebra isomorphism expected by the Hikita–Nakajima conjecture. However, in examples for which the quantum Hikita conjecture is proven in [KMP21], $H^{*}_{T^{!}\times\mathbb{G}_{m}}(X^{!})$ is generated by degree $2$ classes.
∎

paper.title: 3D mirror symmetry in positive characteristic
paper.abstract: Via the formulation of (quantum) Hikita conjecture with coefficients in a characteristic $p$ field, we explain an arithmetic aspect of the theory of 3D mirror symmetry. Namely, we propose that the action of Steenrod-type operations and Frobenius-constant quantizations intertwine under the (quantum) Hikita isomorphism for 3D mirror pairs, and verify this for the Springer resolutions and hypertoric varieties.
